experiment: BMRC branchwise MSE leave-one-generator-out, balanced 2-second evaluation
split: Each real source and each known fake generator is split 50/15/15/20. The held-out fake target is excluded entirely from training and validation. Train MSE heads on train portions of real sources and all non-target fake groups. Validation sets choose early stopping.
evaluation: For each target generator, take its held-out target fakes and the 20% held-out real portions; deterministic balanced sample with n=min(real_test,fake_target). STALL and BMRC scores use identical IDs.
feature_calibration: Original VATEX DINOv3 real-reference likelihood parameters; frame and normalized-transition likelihood descriptor formulas match BMRC FeatureExtractor. Stored per-frame log-likelihoods recompute exactly from final_cls and the pinned parameters.
metrics: AUROC and average precision with real clips as positive; per-generator BMRC mean and sample SD over 3 optimization seeds; STALL is fixed per test sample.
limitations: 20 generator groups available at 2 seconds, not all rows in the STALL paper table
VideoFeedback HotShot-XL and GenVideo HotShot-XL/MoonValley 2-second rows unavailable
seeds vary optimization only; they are not independent dataset replicates
within-benchmark training uses the other generator groups and therefore does not test zero-shot or no-label transfer
